title: About Us
body:
Welcome to JUBELAY — Where Style Meets Simplicity.

JUBELAY was born from a simple idea: every woman deserves to feel confident and beautiful in her hijab, without the hassle of complicated styling.

We understand the daily struggle — rushing in the morning, pins that damage fabric, hijabs that slip. That's why we created our signature Instant Jersey Hijab Sets: ready-to-wear, comfortable, and effortlessly elegant.

What Makes JUBELAY Different

  • Premium Quality Fabric — Soft, breathable jersey that stays in place all day
  • Ready to Wear — Built-in cap, just slip on and go
  • Magnetic Pins Included — No holes, no damage to your favorite hijabs
  • Free Size — Designed to fit comfortably
  • Fast COD Delivery — Across Pakistan, 2-5 working days

Our Mission

To make modest fashion accessible, affordable, and absolutely beautiful for every Pakistani woman.

Every JUBELAY product is carefully selected and quality-checked before it reaches your doorstep. We believe that looking good shouldn't be complicated — it should be simple, just like our tagline says: Style Made Simple.

Thank you for choosing JUBELAY. We're honored to be part of your style journey.

With love,
Team JUBELAY

title: FAQ
body:
Ordering

Q: How do I place an order?
A: Browse our collection, add items to cart, and checkout. Pay via COD, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or Bank Transfer.

Q: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
A: Yes! COD is available across Pakistan.

Q: Can I order via WhatsApp?
A: Yes! Message us at 03XX-XXXXXXX.

Payment

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: COD, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and Bank Transfer.

Shipping & Delivery

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Major cities: 2-3 days. Other cities: 4-5 days. Remote areas: 5-7 days.

Q: How much is shipping?
A: FREE on orders above Rs. 2,000. Below Rs. 2,000: Rs. 200.

Products

Q: What size are JUBELAY hijabs?
A: All Instant Jersey Hijabs are FREE SIZE.

Q: What's included in the Hijab Set?
A: 1 Instant Jersey Hijab (built-in cap) + 2 Magnetic Pins + 1 Branded JUBELAY Pouch.

Returns & Exchanges

Q: What is your return policy?
A: Returns/exchanges within 3 days. Product must be unused with original packaging.

title: Shipping & Delivery
body:
JUBELAY delivers across Pakistan!

Delivery Times

  • Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad: 2-3 working days
  • Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan: 3-4 working days
  • Other major cities: 4-5 working days
  • Remote areas: 5-7 working days

Shipping Charges

  • Orders above Rs. 2,000: FREE
  • Orders below Rs. 2,000: Rs. 200

Cash on Delivery

COD available nationwide. Pay the courier on delivery. Inspect before paying.

Courier Partners: PostEx | Leopards | TCS

title: Return & Exchange
body:
Return Policy

  • Within 3 days of delivery
  • Unused, unworn, original packaging intact

Exchange Policy

  • Within 3 days for different color/product
  • Pay difference if higher price

How to Return

  1. WhatsApp 03XX-XXXXXXX within 3 days
  2. Share order number + reason
  3. Ship back (or pickup in major cities)
  4. Refund in 5-7 working days via JazzCash/EasyPaisa/Bank

Return Shipping: Customer pays (except defective/wrong items).

Non-Returnable: Worn, washed, or damaged items.
